title: Been Here Before
voice_standard: Liam - conspiratorial, awed, warm; the friend explaining the glitch

scenes.text: It's about to happen again. And when it does, I want you to remember this video.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The sudden stop: the moment before the feeling strikes.
scenes.query: person pausing suddenly on busy street looking around

scenes.text: You'll be somewhere ordinary. Mid-sentence. Mid-step. And a wave will hit you:
scenes.semantic_anchor: The wave that arrives mid-step.
scenes.query: slow motion wave rolling over calm shore dusk purple

scenes.text: I have been here before. This exact light. This exact sentence. This exact... everything.
scenes.semantic_anchor: PREMIUM GRAPHIC: the same moment shown twice, overlapping as violet and magenta double-exposure ghosts, one a half-step ahead.
scenes.image_prompt: a surreal double-exposure of the same dim room overlapping itself slightly offset, violet and magenta ghost images out of phase, glitch shimmer between them, premium cinematic deja vu, no people's faces

scenes.text: Déjà vu. Two French words for the strangest feeling a healthy brain can make.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Old film leader flickering: the feeling given its name.
scenes.query: vintage film countdown leader flickering projector green

scenes.text: And for a few seconds, you genuinely can't tell: is this a memory... or is it now?
scenes.semantic_anchor: Holding a photo of a moment that feels like the present.
scenes.query: person looking at old photographs confused lamplight

scenes.text: Here's what science thinks is actually happening. And it's better than magic.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Leaning into the mechanism: better than magic.
scenes.query: scientist examining glowing sample in dark lab purple light

scenes.text: Your brain runs a familiarity detector. A little stamp that marks every experience: seen it. Know it. Old news.
scenes.semantic_anchor: PREMIUM GRAPHIC: an ornate silver seal-press stamping glowing frames on a film strip conveyor, violet light, no lettering on the stamp.
scenes.image_prompt: an ornate dimensional silver seal-press machine stamping a soft glowing mark onto frames of a luminous film strip moving on a conveyor, violet and magenta lighting, premium cinematic machinery, no letters or text on anything

scenes.text: And separately, it runs a recall system — the one that fetches the actual footage of your past.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The archive hand: recall fetching real footage.
scenes.query: hand pulling old film reel from archive shelf

scenes.text: Normally they fire together. You see your kitchen: stamp says familiar, archive says here's why.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The kitchen: familiarity and memory in agreement.
scenes.query: morning kitchen sunlight steam from coffee cozy

scenes.text: But once in a while... the stamp fires alone.
scenes.semantic_anchor: PREMIUM GRAPHIC: the seal-press striking a completely blank glowing frame, sparks of violet light, the archive shelf behind it dark and still.
scenes.image_prompt: the ornate silver seal-press striking down onto a blank glowing empty film frame, violet electric sparks at the moment of impact, behind it a dark motionless archive, dramatic premium machinery art, no text

scenes.text: The moment gets marked 'already seen'... while it is still arriving. Fresh experience, wearing a vintage label.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Something new wrapped in something old: the mislabeled moment.
scenes.query: new product being wrapped in old newspaper hands

scenes.text: Your archive scrambles to find the matching footage. There is none. And THAT is the shiver.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Empty shelves where the matching reel should be.
scenes.query: empty film archive shelves dark rows

scenes.text: The eerie part of déjà vu isn't the memory. It's your brain catching itself in a lie... in real time.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A cracked reflection: the system seeing its own error.
scenes.query: cracked mirror reflecting light fragments purple

scenes.text: Think about what that means. You just watched quality control happen inside your own mind.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Quality control on the line: error-checking made visible.
scenes.query: inspector examining products on conveyor line with light

scenes.text: Most of the time, the machinery is invisible. The stamps, the archives, the wiring — all backstage.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The backstage rigging you never see.
scenes.query: backstage theater ropes and pulleys dim green light

scenes.text: Déjà vu is the one moment the curtain slips. The stagehand caught in the spotlight.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The slipped curtain: machinery briefly exposed.
scenes.query: stage curtain slightly open spotlight through gap

scenes.text: And here's the beautiful twist: young brains get it MORE. It fades as you age.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Youth, where the glitch fires most.
scenes.query: children running through sprinkler golden summer

scenes.text: Because déjà vu isn't the system failing. It's the system CHECKING. A sharp brain catches its own false alarms.
scenes.semantic_anchor: PREMIUM GRAPHIC: a luminous network of nodes, one node flashing magenta as rings of verification light sweep back over it, violet lattice.
scenes.image_prompt: a dimensional luminous lattice network of glowing nodes in violet space, one node flashing magenta while elegant rings of verification light sweep across and correct it, premium network schematic, glitch-beautiful, no text

scenes.text: An old brain that never gets déjà vu isn't wiser. Its inspector just stopped showing up.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The silent factory: inspection that no longer runs.
scenes.query: empty factory floor machines stopped dust light

scenes.text: So the next time the wave hits — the light too familiar, the sentence already spoken — don't be afraid.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Standing calm inside the wave.
scenes.query: person standing calm in purple dusk light breeze

scenes.text: Don't reach for past lives or glitching simulations. What's happening is stranger than both.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Grander than the myths: the real mechanism.
scenes.query: galaxy time lapse stars rotating night sky

scenes.text: You are watching the machine that builds your reality... proofread itself.
scenes.semantic_anchor: PREMIUM GRAPHIC: a great luminous editing desk where reality's film strip is inspected under a violet lamp by unseen presence.
scenes.image_prompt: a grand dimensional editing desk in darkness where a luminous film strip of reality is being inspected under a single violet lamp, magnifying lens hovering, unseen editor, premium cinematic mystery, no text

scenes.text: For three seconds, you get to stand behind your own eyes and watch the edit happen.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Behind your own eyes as the edit runs.
scenes.query: eye extreme close up reflecting purple light macro

scenes.text: So next time... smile. You caught the machine mid-edit.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The knowing smile of the catch.
scenes.query: person smiling knowingly at camera dusk light close

scenes.text: ...And it noticed you noticing.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The violet node-lattice turning, one ring of light sweeping back toward the viewer, aware.
scenes.image_prompt: the luminous violet lattice network slowly turning in dark space, a single elegant ring of magenta light sweeping outward toward the viewer as if aware of being observed, serene eerie premium art, no text
